Simplistic, and it always bugs me a bit when Foundation personnel are shown to be unable to maintain their calm in the face of typical day to day horrors(unless that's supposed to be an additional effect of the object?).

But that said this was engaging and interesting to read, and I had to wince at the mental image it gave me, so it deserves my upvote for being effective.

Author: Km. Mortarion
Translator: Mafiew
Date of creation: 2015-02-25
Original: SCP-024-FR in the French branch
Translation: SCP-024-FR in the Translation Archive

Additional Context:
French SCPs use a threat level in addition to the normal classification, which is indicated with a color code. You can find an overview of the color codes here.

Color code Yellow means:
The object is harmful but easy to recontain. This may indicate that it can quickly be brought under control as long as certain, easily achievable conditions are met. May be assigned to either Safe, Euclid or even Keter class objects.
